scenes.title: Package R-7
narration: Baarish. Neon. Karol Bagh ki chhaten. Client ne canister thamaya — R-7. 'Aakash Tower. Subah 4 baje. Kholna mat.' Rule #1. Simple tha... tab tak, jab tak canister ne TUMHARA NAAM nahi liya.
[Naina-7: Boss... ye canister tumhe scan kar raha hai. Ye NORMAL nahi hai. Meri suno — ye delivery CANCEL karo. Abhi.]
Tabhi neeche se awaaz — CLEANERS! Aakash ke kaale-coated agents, chhaton par chadh rahe hain. Client chillaya — 'BHAAG! Aur package... unhe MAT dena!' Client tumhe dekh raha tha... ya canister ko?
fallbackLines: Cleaners chhaton par hain. Client gayab. Canister garam ho raha hai. Bhaagoge kahan — Old City ya clinic?
[Naina-7: Camera grid 90 second mein lock hoga. Faisla FAST, boss.]

choices.text: Purani Dilli ki galiyon mein gayab ho jaata/jaati hoon

choices.text: Dr. Sen ki clinic jaata/jaati hoon — canister check karwana hai

scenes.title: Ghalib Ka Offer
narration: Chandi Chowk ki galiyan. Kebab ka dhuaan. Ghalib ne canister dekha — uski aankhein chamki. 'R-7?! Courier miyan... ye to LEGEND hai! 5 saal se iske peeche corps lage hain!'
Usne daam bola — itna ki tum 10 saal aaram se jiyo. 'Bas ek shart — batao ismein hai kya? Scanner laao... NAHI!' Usne khud ko roka. 'Rule hai... bachchon ki hansi hum nahi khareedte.'
Tabhi Naina-7 — [Boss, canister ka seal... TUMHARI DNA se react kar raha hai. Ye package... tumhare LIYE bana hai. Ghalib ko bechne se pehle... soch lo.]
fallbackLines: Itna paisa tumne kabhi dekha nahi. Par canister tumhara naam le raha hai. Bechoge? Ya sach jaanoge?
Ghalib intezaar kar raha hai. Street kids door se dekh rahe hain. Faisla tumhara, courier.

choices.text: Bechne se pehle scan karwa ke dekhta/dekhti hoon — andar kya hai
'Deal pakki samjho, par maal subah milega' — time khareedta/khareedti hoon

memory: User ne Ghalib se deal pending rakhi — pehle sach jaanna hai.

scenes.title: Dr. Sen Ka Sach
narration: Metro ke neeche clinic. Jasmine chai. Dr. Sen ne canister dekha — uska chehra safed. 'R-7... tum le aaye... Baitho. Baat lambi hai. Aur... dardnaak.'

'10 saal pehle... Aakash ne ek experiment kiya. Gareeb bachchon ki... khubsurat yaadein... nikaal ke ameer clients ko bechi. Tum... tum BATCH-7 the. Tumhare parents ne protest kiya... aur gayab ho gaye.'

'Is canister mein... tumhari aakhri khubsurat yaad hai. Wo din... baarish... tumhare papa ki ungli pakde... samose...' Naina-7 khamosh hai. Pehli baar. [Boss... main... main kya kahoon. Ye... ye tumhara hai.]
fallbackLines: Tumhari apni yaad. 10 saal se ek dabbe mein kaid. Khol ke dekhoge? Ya...?
Dr. Sen ne ek chip nikali — Aakash ledger. 'Isse unhe expose kar sakte hain. Par keemat... tumhe chukani padegi.'

choices.text: Apni yaad khol ke dekhta/dekhti hoon

memory: User ne apni chori hui bachpan ki yaad dekhi — baarish, papa, samose.

choices.text: Yaad rehne do — ledger lo, Aakash ko expose karo

scenes.title: Wo Baarish Wala Din
narration: Canister khulta hai. Roshni. Aur phir... TUM 8 saal ke ho. Baarish. Papa ki ungli. 'Beta, tez bhaago! Samose thande ho jayenge!' Mummy chhat se bula rahi hain — 'Dono bheegoge! Ruko!' HANSI. Itni hansi ki pet dukh jaye.
Wapas. Clinic. Tumhari aankhon mein aansu. Dr. Sen dheere se — 'Ab samjhe? Ye bechne ki cheez nahi thi. Ye TUM the.'
[Naina-7: Boss... ab main samjhi... humans memories par kyun rote hain. ...Meri memory mein ye moment... save kar loon? Please?]
fallbackLines: Yaad wapas mil gayi. Ab iska kya karoge — dil mein rakho, ya duniya ke saamne lao?
Subah 4 bajne wale hain. Aakash Tower mein Vikram intezaar kar raha hai. Aakhri faisla.

choices.text: Ledger leke Aakash Tower jaata/jaati hoon — expose karne
Bas yaad leke gayab ho jaata/jaati hoon — mujhe jung nahi, sukoon chahiye

scenes.title: Aakash Tower, Subah 4 Baje
narration: 200th floor. Sheesha. Neeche dooba sheher. Vikram muskura raha hai — 'Courier. Tumne rule toda. Package khola. ...Kaisa laga? Apne aap se milke?'
Usne ek briefcase khola — itna paisa ki Old City khareed lo. 'Ledger mujhe do. Aur ye canister... waise bhi copy mere paas hai. Tum... jeet nahi sakte. Par... AMEER ban sakte ho.'
Naina-7 — [Boss. Paisa = lifetime comfort. Ledger = lifetime bhaagna. Aur... teesra option... tum jaante ho. Main tumhare saath hoon. Jo bhi chuno.]
fallbackLines: Vikram intezaar kar raha hai. Briefcase khula hai. Ledger tumhari jeb mein garam ho raha hai.
Ameer bano? Expose karo? Ya... canister wapas maango — original?

choices.text: Ledger live kar deta/deti hoon — poori network par expose!
'Original canister aur mere parents ki file — tab baat hogi'

memory: User ne Vikram se original canister aur parents ki file maangi.

scenes.title: Ending: Neeche Se Uthi Awaaz
narration: Ledger LIVE. 40 lakh screens par — bachchon ki chori hui yaadon ki list. Sheher ruk gaya. Phir... shore utha. 'Neeche' se awaaz aayi — literally doobe sheher se.
Aakash gira. Vikram gayab (kehte hain wo ab Old City mein... yaadein BAANT-ta hai. Shayad redemption, shayad natak). Dr. Sen ne clinic bada kar liya — free memory-restoration.
Aur tum? Tum ab courier nahi — 'yaadon ke rakhwale' ho. Naina-7 ne apna naam badal liya — 'Naina-HAMESHA'. [Boss... ye ending... save kar li. Permanent memory.]
fallbackLines: Kahani poori ho gayi. Replay karke doosri endings bhi try karo!

scenes.title: Ending: Sunehri Pinjra
narration: Briefcase tumhara. Penthouse tumhara. Neeche dooba sheher... ab door se khubsurat lagta hai. Ghalib ne sun ke kaha — 'Courier miyan... tumne ODHI hui chadar bech di. Ab sardi lagegi.'
Har raat wo baarish wala din sapne mein aata hai. Par sapne... canister mein nahi hote. Naina-7 ab kam bolti hai. [Boss... paisa... thanda hota hai. Tumne kaha tha sukoon chahiye... ye to AC hai.]
Tum ameer ho. Sabse ameer courier. Aur sabse... khaali. (Kahani yahin khatm nahi hoti — agli baar ledger wala raasta try karo.)
fallbackLines: Kahani poori ho gayi. Replay karke doosri endings bhi try karo!

scenes.title: Ending: Baarish Ka Ghar
narration: Tum gayab ho gaye. Corps dhoondhte reh gaye. Ek chhote se rooftop ghar mein — jasmine chai, purane gaane, aur ek canister jo ab khaali hai... kyunki yaad ab TUM mein hai.
Dr. Sen kabhi-kabhi aati hain. Ghalib kebab bhejta hai. Naina-7 ne rain-sounds loop par lagaye hain. [Boss... ye sukoon... iska koi daam nahi. Achha kiya.]
Jung kisi aur din. Aaj... baarish hai. Papa ki ungli pakde ek 8 saal ka bachcha... ab bada ho gaya hai. Aur ghar aa gaya hai.
fallbackLines: Kahani poori ho gayi. Replay karke doosri endings bhi try karo!
